newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Golden State in mine venture with Heron.
newsitem.headline: Golden State in mine venture with Heron.

text.p: Golden State Resources NL said on Tuesday it had reached an joint venture agreement with Heron Resources NL that enables it to earn 60 percent of the Menzie gold project in Western Australia by spending A$250,000 on exploration over four years.

The Heron Resources joint venture covers seven square kilometres immediately to the south and contiguous with Golden State's existing Merrey Well holding, where partners Golden State 60 percent, Dalrymple Resources 20 percent and Julia Gold Pty Ltd 20 percent are test drilling, the compay said.
The new joint venture increases Golden State's holding at the Merrey Well prospect to 19 square kilometres, the company said.
